Corporate Governance · September 30, 2025

Makamin Saudi Holding Convenes Extraordinary General Assembly with Major Shareholder Participation

Makamin Saudi Holding Company for Oil & Gas Services held its Extraordinary General Assembly on September 30, 2025, with the participation of major shareholders and representatives of shareholder companies, alongside attendees from Saudi Arabia and abroad.

Participants included representatives of Al-Durra Petroleum Services, Bait Al-Taqa, Bin Tami, and Ajlan Al-Ajlan, as well as other shareholders. Among the attendees from Kuwait was Dr. Eng. Khaled Al-Saif.

Agenda Review and Voting Procedures

The Assembly commenced at 12:00 noon and continued until 4:30 p.m.

Voting was conducted on the first agenda item only, given its significance, while the remaining items were deferred to a later stage pending completion of the required alignment.

Votes were counted manually, with voting and representation eligibility controls applied. Individuals whose powers of attorney did not authorize voting were not permitted to cast votes.

These procedures reflected the Company's commitment to the integrity of voting processes, compliance with applicable rules and instructions, and the principles of transparency and corporate governance.

Shareholder Participation and Acknowledgments

The Company expressed its appreciation to shareholders who participated in the Assembly, whether in person or through electronic communication channels, and acknowledged those who were unable to attend.

The Company also thanked the Assembly Secretary, the secretariat team, and the observers for their efforts in organizing the meeting and administering its proceedings.

Special appreciation was extended to Ajlan Al-Ajlan and Bin Tami for their support, as well as to the shareholders, engineers, and other professionals who contributed to the Assembly.

Strengthening Corporate Governance

The Assembly reflected Makamin Saudi Holding's focus on structured shareholder meetings, clear voting and representation procedures, and the orderly consideration of agenda items.

The Company continues its efforts to strengthen corporate governance practices and support shareholder participation in its institutional recovery and development initiatives.
